text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and Stock E at steep losses was painful, but holding them solely to avoid realizing a loss would not be a sound plan; I should reassess each holding on its outlook and portfolio role.","After selling Stock C for a gain, I later bought it again at a higher price. I should judge each buy or sell on the current opportunity, not anchor on my earlier sale price or average cost.","My account kept declining while I rarely traded, so I should check in periodically and make deliberate decisions—without confusing patience with neglect."]}
